featured_reviews.name: Nandan Dixit
featured_reviews.review_text:
In February 2026, we were two senior women who traveled to a few places that were on the Buddha Circuit (mostly Bihar as well as Sarnath in UP). Tibro Tours arranged all the ground transportation, hotels, breakfast-dinner meals, and guides at the sightseeing locations. We visited Sarnath, Bodh Gaya, Rajgir, Nalanda, Vaishali, and our last night was in Patna. Tibro Tours did a great job providing us a comfortable car and driver for the entire tour. The driver was professional, drove well, was always reachable on phone, punctual, friendly, and knew the roads and cities/towns in the region.

During the trip, we stayed at five different hotels. We also had breakfast and dinner included every day at each of the hotels. The first three hotels were:
Sarnath (Fern Residency),
Bodh Gaya (Nirvana Grand Hotel and Resort),
Rajgir (Hotel Thatagat Ashok)
They were good with comfortable and clean rooms, good amenities and services, as well as meals.

However, our hotel in Vaishali (Vaishali Residency) was not adequate. The hotel was a large hotel with long hallways, and we were the only two guests there that night which was a bit spooky. Although our room was large, it appeared to be old and dilapidated and the bathroom smelled of mold. I think the hotel needs to be renovated! Luckily, the staff at the hotel were attentive and helpful so we were happy with their service. As an example, one of us was sick and they made some simple food specially for us to eat.

Our last hotel in Patna (Gargee Grand) was also well below our expectations. The hotel room and bathroom were small and cramped and the general vibe of the hotel's location and the hotel room was a bit rundown. We have asked Tibro Tours to reconsider reserving these last two hotels for their future guests.

Overall, Tibro Tours did a good job organizing our tour, and it was a relief to know that their staff was available at any time to resolve any issues that we might have while we were traveling in unfamiliar places in Bihar. We just had to contact them. Thanks to Tibro Tours, we now have some beautiful and lasting memories of the wonderful and ancient history of these places that we visited on the Buddha Circuit.
